events.content:
Changes:

- **`app/page.tsx`** — now fully static: renders `<h1>` + three Suspense boundaries with static fallbacks. This whole tree lands in the PPR shell.
- **`app/data.ts`** — shared `React.cache`-wrapped fetcher so each component can `await` it without refetching.
- **`app/CardStats.tsx` / `RevenueChart.tsx` / `LatestInvoices.tsx`** — each is now an async Server Component fetching its own slice. They're the dynamic holes streamed in after the shell.
- **`app/loading.tsx`** — removed. The route-level boundary was pulling everything out of the shell; per-component Suspense replaces it.

Result: the shell now contains the header, grid structure, and section placeholders — not just `<body>`.

content.text:
Changes:

- **`app/page.tsx`** — now fully static: renders `<h1>` + three Suspense boundaries with static fallbacks. This whole tree lands in the PPR shell.
- **`app/data.ts`** — shared `React.cache`-wrapped fetcher so each component can `await` it without refetching.
- **`app/CardStats.tsx` / `RevenueChart.tsx` / `LatestInvoices.tsx`** — each is now an async Server Component fetching its own slice. They're the dynamic holes streamed in after the shell.
- **`app/loading.tsx`** — removed. The route-level boundary was pulling everything out of the shell; per-component Suspense replaces it.

Result: the shell now contains the header, grid structure, and section placeholders — not just `<body>`.
